title: A Stomach Ache
description: "Mojang" "added" new food to the game, and this is it! This was for April Fools'.
body:
# Just got a Stomach Ache
This mod is taken from viewer suggestions once again! This time, it was "Mojang" who made the mod. Of course, that was a joke, as this was an April Fools' mod made for a video.
<iframe width="560" height="315" src="https://www.youtube-nocookie.com/embed/3NBmL2wkMvQ" title="YouTube video player" frameborder="0" allow="accelerometer; autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture; web-share" allowfullscreen></iframe>

## What's new?
- 4 new Soups and Stews:
  - Dirt Stew: Actively takes AWAY your hunger bars.
  - Sand Stew: Gets sand in your mouth.
  - Mud Soup: Mmm, mud! Moderately nutritious.
  - Soup Stew: Beetroot Soup in a bowl in a bowl!
- 3 new Apple types
  - Redstone Apple: Start leaving a trail of Redstone!
  - Gunpowder Apple: Literally just Gunpowder. But Apple.
  - TNT Apple: Will obliterate you, Netherite armor or not!
- Rice
  - Rice Bowl: Rice in a bowl.
  - Fried Rice Bowl: YOU'RE TELLING ME A _**SHRIMP**_ FRIED THIS RICE???
  - Rice Plant: Grows in most overworld forest biomes.
- Uranium
  - Sift: Can sift through dirt to find things in soil.
  - Uranium: WARNING! Do no eat uranium in real life. In Minecraft, it sends you to the Nether.
  - Uranium Block: Uranium Decor!
- New Villager Profession
  - Soupiter: Sells you soups, stews, and bowls galore.
- 5 new Pizzas
  - Pizza Crust: The base of any pizza.
  - Cheese Pizza: A simple one, but a classic. _Not_ made with real cheese.
  - Carrot & Potato Pizza: Grab your crops! New uses just hit the shelves.
  - Porkchop Pizza: Pig on a pizza? News to me!
  - Hawaiian Pizza: I have no opinion on this matter.

### Credits
Thanks to​​ ⁨@bombybrorants⁩, @A_unfunnyguy⁩, @FoxesAreGods660⁩, the user who suggested "Rice" on Minecraft Feedback page, and @Corony-o6t⁩ for suggesting features for this mod.
